## Use Comic Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Comic Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Comic Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Comic Mono coding font

A monospaced version of Comic Sans. Comic Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Comic Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Comic Mono FAQ

### Is Comic Mono free?

Yes. Comic Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Comic Mono support ligatures?

No. Comic Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Comic Mono?

Comic Mono is available from GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
